Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

ISt4787.1968 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
TABLE, EXAMINATION 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution 
on 18 October 1968, after the draft finalized by the Hospital Equipment 
Sectional Committee had been approved by the Consumer Products Division 
Council. 

0.2 The formulation of Indian Standards on hospital' equipment has been 
taken up at the instance of the Advisory Committee for Development of 
Surgical Instruments, Equipment and Appliances, Government of India. 

0.3 .This standard forms one of a scries of Indian Standards on hospital 
furnituie. Other standards in the series are: 

IS:4033-1%8 General requirements for hospital furniture 

IS:4034-1%8 Castors for hospital equipment 

18:4035-1967 Trolleys, stretcher 

18:4036-1967 Trolleys, patient 

18:4037-1967 Stretcher and stretcher carriers 

18:4266-1967 Lockers, bedside for hospital use 

18:4267-1967 Stands, wash hand basin 

18:4455-1967 Trolleys, soiled linen 

18:4458-1967 Screens, bedside 

18:4494-1968 Tables, overbed 

18:4769-1968 Trolley, dressing 

6A 18:4033-1968''' is a necessary adjunct to this standard. 

0.5 Clause 5.1 calls for an agrotynent between the purchaser and the 
supplier. 

0*6 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, express- 
ing the result of a test, shall be rounded oflfin accordance with IS : 2-19(501. 
The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should 
be the same as tluit of the specified valu> in this standard. 

'General rcquiremenu for hospital furniture. 
fRulet for rounding off numerical values ( nvistd ).

ISt4787-1968 

1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard specifies the requirements of examination tables used in 
hospitals and other similar institutions. 

2. TERMINOLOGY 

2.0 For the purpose of this standard the definition given in 2.1 shall apply. 

2.1 Table, Examination — Table used for the purpose of examination of 
patients in the consulting rooms, clinics and side-rooms of hospital wards. 

3. MATERIALS 

3.1 Framework — This shall be according to 2.1 of IS : 4033-1968*. 

3.2 Top— -This shall conform to 2.2(a) of IS : 4033-1968*. 

3.3 Rods, Ghannela and Strips — These shall be of mild steel, either 
cold-rolled or hot-rolled <]uality. 

4. DIMENSIONS 

4.1 The main dimensions of examination table shall be as given in Fig. I. 

4.2 The thickness of tubes used and their corresponding outside diameters 
for different parts shall be as given below: 

Part Outside Diameter of Tube Thickness of Tube 

mm mm 



Vertical members 31 

Horizontal members 25 



•75 \ 
•40 / 



1-02 



4.3 The mild steel sheet used for top and head rest shall have a minimum 
thickness of 1-22 mm. 

5. MANUFACTURE 

5.1 Fran&ework — The examination table shall have a framework of 
single continuous lengths of mild steel tubes as shown in Fig. 1 . At the floor 
end, the four upright members shall be connected together by longitudinal 
and transverse tie rods and at the other end these shall support a formed 
sheet metal top. For receiving the sheet metal top, the top ends of the 
uprights shall oe flattened and thereafter welded to the top. Any other 
arrangement of fixing the sheet metal top to the framework shall be agreed 
to by the purchaser and the manufacturer, but in either case the top so 
obtained shall be sturdy in construction. The head rest shall have the same 
construction as the top and it shall be adjustable on a rack for obtaining 



*General requirement! for hospital furniture.

various positions. The floor ends of the upright members or legs shall be 
fitted with metal shoes. The rest of the details shall be according to 4 of 
18:4033-1968*. 

6. FINISH 

6.1 The requirements as specified in 5 of IS : 4033-1968* shall apply. 

7. TESTS 

7.1 Adhesion Test —This shall conform to 6.1.1 of 15:4033-1968*. 

7.2 Performance Test — The head rest shall stand the test given in 7.2.1 
in various positions obtained by adjusting the rack. 

7.2.1 In any positition of head rest, with a load of 25 kgf spread over 
the entire width of head rest, there shall be no excessive sideways play and 
also the head rest shall be stable. 

8. MARKING 

8.1 The marking shall be as specified in 7 of IS : 4033-1968*. 

9. PACKING 

9.1 The packing shall be as specified in 8 of IS : 4033-1968*. 



*Gener*l requirements for hospital furniture.
